arithmeticContract.binary32BasicOperations: Every nontrivial interval operation encloses adjacent float32 values around RN endpoints (one-ULP operation allowance); zero-preserving operations stay exact zero.
arithmeticContract.sourceRho: float32(0.96) multiplied by shader-linear dyadic base color, unit tint; no receiver rho inside raw D
arithmeticContract.division: Union of directly rounded division and reciprocal (2^-21 relative) followed by rounded multiply. Weight gamma8 encloses reciprocal plus multiply; grid-one ratio gamma8 encloses first multiply, reciprocal and last multiply.
arithmeticContract.accumulation: 16 ray multiply/adds and division for each cache estimate; actual alpha=min/max sample recurrence and both lerp forms; 8 ray multiply/adds and division for gather
arithmeticContract.storage: positive finite final binary16 interval [RTZ(lower), RNE(upper)]; exact black remains [0,0]
arithmeticContract.scope: Conditional finite input/DXR geometric classification and stated arithmetic implementation class; not a universal hardware error theorem
